fields.label: Pricing Type
fields.description: Which calculator this cost fact belongs to

Let the user add multiple blocks in the calculator (a repeatable table of the attributes below). Each block produces its own cost line, e.g. 'Embossing Block (7 x 9) * 2'. The Qty/Rate formulas are evaluated once per block.
fields.label: Allow Multiple Blocks
Qty Formula
fields.description:
Formula to calculate Required Qty. Available variables:
  Attributes: attr.length  attr.width  attr.qty  (or any name from Attributes table)
  Sheet:      full_sheet_qty  cut_sheet_qty  cut_sheet_area  cut_sheet_ups
              no_of_colors  item_qty  no_of_cuts  no_of_ups
  Math:       ceil()  floor()  max()  min()  abs()  round()

Examples:
  attr.qty                         → number of blocks
  no_of_colors                     → one per color
  cut_sheet_qty * no_of_colors     → cut sheets × colors
  item_qty                         → full order quantity
  ceil(item_qty / attr.per_box)    → boxes needed (rounded up)
  1                                → fixed qty

Leave blank to use the legacy Calculation keyword or enter qty manually.

fields.label: Rate Formula
fields.description:
Formula to calculate the Rate (LKR). Available variables:
  item_rate     — price list rate of the selected item
  fix_rate      — fixed rate stored on the Cost Fact Item row
  material_rate — base material rate from the order form
  Attributes:   attr.length  attr.width  attr.qty  (same as above)
  Sheet:        cut_sheet_area  no_of_colors  item_qty  etc.
  Math:         ceil()  floor()  max()  min()  abs()

Examples:
  item_rate                              → standard price list rate
  fix_rate                               → fixed rate on item row
  attr.length * attr.width * item_rate   → area × rate/sqin
  item_rate * no_of_colors               → rate per color
  max(item_rate, fix_rate)               → use the higher rate

Leave blank to use standard rate logic (price list → valuation rate).

fields.label: Calculation
fields.description:
LEGACY — only used when Qty Formula above is empty.

Keyword options:
  full_sheet_qty        → full sheet quantity
  cut_sheet_qty         → cut sheet quantity
  cut_sheet_area        → cut sheets × cut sheet area
  no_of_colors          → number of colors
  cut_sheet_qty_colors  → cut sheets × colors
  order_qty             → item quantity ordered
  fixed                 → always 1
  block_area            → attr.length × attr.width × attr.qty

Recommended: use Qty Formula instead.

fields.label: Min Qty
fields.description:
Minimum LKR charge for this cost item.

If (req_qty × rate) < Min Qty, the system uses Min Qty as the final amount.

Examples:
  Die Cutter: 3500  → minimum charge LKR 3,500
  Sorting:    2000  → minimum charge LKR 2,000
  Delivery:      0  → no minimum

fields.label: UOM
fields.description: Unit of measure displayed in cost breakdown (e.g. PCS, SQINCH, NOS, HRS)
